title: Half Marathon Races in Thailand: 2026-2027 Calendar
intro: Nine half marathons spread across Thailand, with Bangkok appearing twice and Chiang Mai hosting two separate events of its own. The calendar clusters heavily into the final third of the year: two races in September, one in October, two in November, and two more in December, before a gap until single events in January and May 2027. Runners are choosing between very different settings — a Bangkok night race, a beach town in Bangsaen, the hills around Chiang Mai and Mae Moh, and coastal Krabi at Ao Nang. Most events measure the full 21.1km alongside shorter 10km, 5km, or 3km options run on the same day.

faqs.question: When is half marathon season in Thailand?
faqs.answer: The busiest stretch runs from September through December 2026, with two races in September, one in October, two in November, and two in December. After that the calendar thins out, with just one race in January 2027 and another in May 2027, so most choices cluster in the last four months of the year.

faqs.question: Which cities host more than one half marathon?
faqs.answer: Bangkok and Chiang Mai each have two entries. Bangkok hosts the Bangkok Midnight Marathon in December and the Thai Sikh Run in January, while Chiang Mai hosts the Scenic Half Marathon (CMSH) in November and RUN FOR FREEDOM – Bitcoin Thailand Half Marathon, also in November.

faqs.question: How do these races differ in distance options?
faqs.answer: All nine include the full 21.1km distance, but several pair it with shorter runs on race day. Mae Moh Half Marathon and RUN FOR FREEDOM offer 21.1/10/5km, Bangkok Midnight Marathon and Thai Sikh Run pair 21.098km with 10km, and Scenic Half Marathon Chiang Mai adds a 3km option alongside 21.1/10/5km.

editorial_pick: The Buriram Marathon (87/100) tops this list by a clear margin -- run on the Chang International Circuit, Thailand's MotoGP venue turned marathon course.
